programmes.d: Arnold can't help but talk about his workout habits and Johnny jokes about killer bees. Ed Begley Jr. and Ginger McLamb also appear.
Ted Danson has a hit show on his hands in Cheers and Courteney Cox enjoys being single in this episode.
Garry Shandling does a standup routine and inventor Joe Newman talks with Johnny.
Sean Penn has a special message for his wife Madonna and Richard Pryor talks about his new Ferrari.

Danny DeVito appears on the couch, as well as Rohan Varavadekar and Calvin Trillin.
Don Johnson is a surprise guest in this episode, which also features David Brenner and Dale Robertson.
